title: Beat sheet artefact (paradigm-specific structural slots)
description: A paradigm-specific beat sheet. Beats are the named structural slots of the chosen paradigm — Save-the-Cat's 15 beats, three-act's setup/confrontation/resolution beats, Kishōtenketsu's ki-shō-ten-ketsu, Harmon's 8 circle stations, Freytag's pyramid stages. The schema is paradigm-neutral on slot identity (beatId is a free string) but enforces ≥3 beats and per-beat label + summary.

paradigm.description: Identifier of the paradigm the beats correspond to (e.g., 'three-act', 'kishotenketsu', 'save-the-cat', 'harmon-circle', 'freytag-pyramid', 'hero-journey').
